summary: Consumer Portfolio Services, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a securitization of approximately $734.51 million of subprime automotive receivables via its wholly owned subsidiary CPS Receivables Five LLC and CPS Auto Receivables Trust 2026-C. The trust issued $716.88 million of asset-backed notes in five classes, secured by the receivables, with over-collateralization and a 1.00% reserve account as credit enhancement. CPS will act as servicer. This is a routine securitization transaction in the ordinary course of business, not a special situation. The filing includes a disclaimer to that effect. No strategic change, acquisition, divestiture, or activist event is indicated.
